# Functional Requirements Document — Application

### Functional Requirement Document (FRD)

#### 1. Requirement ID
• FRD-001: Load Customer and Order Data into Delta Tables
• FRD-002: Clean and Join Customer and Order Data
• FRD-003: Create and Update ordersummary SCD Type 2 Table
• FRD-004: Create and Load customeraggregatespend Table

#### 2. Title
Data Processing and Aggregation for Customer and Order Data

#### 3. Description
The application will read customer and order data from CSV files, clean and join the data, and load it into Delta tables. It will then create and update an ordersummary table using SCD type 2 logic and aggregate the data to load into a customeraggregatespend table.

#### 4. Preconditions
• The CSV files for customer and order data are available at the specified locations.
• The Delta tables and schema exist or can be created as per the specified requirements.

#### 5. Main Flow / Functional Steps

##### 5.1 Load Customer and Order Data into Delta Tables
• Read customer data from CSV file located at `/Volumes/gen_ai_poc_databrickscoe/sdlc_wizard/customerdata` and load into a Delta table named `customer`.
• Read order data from CSV file located at `/Volumes/gen_ai_poc_databrickscoe/sdlc_wizard/orderdata` and load into a Delta table named `order`.

##### 5.2 Clean Customer and Order Data
• Remove records with "Null" or Null values from both `customer` and `order` tables.
• Remove duplicate records from both `customer` and `order` tables.

##### 5.3 Create ordersummary Table if Not Exists
• Check if `ordersummary` table exists in catalog `gen_ai_poc_databrickscoe` and schema `sdlc_wizard`.
• If not, create `ordersummary` table with schema: `CustId`, `Name`, `EmailId`, `Region`, `OrderId`, `ItemName`, `PricePerUnit`, `Qty`, `Date`.

##### 5.4 Join Customer and Order Data and Load into ordersummary Table
• Join `customer` and `order` tables on `CustId` field.
• Load the joined data into `ordersummary` table using SCD type 2 logic.

##### 5.5 Update ordersummary SCD Type 2 Table on Customer Data Change
• Implement logic to update `ordersummary` table whenever there is a change in `customer` table.
• Make old records Inactive and new records Active in `ordersummary` table.
• Update `StartDate` and `EndDate` accordingly.

##### 5.6 Create customeraggregatespend Table if Not Exists
• Check if `customeraggregatespend` table exists in catalog `gen_ai_poc_databrickscoe` and schema `sdlc_wizard`.
• If not, create `customeraggregatespend` table with columns: `Name`, `TotalAmount`, `Date`.

##### 5.7 Aggregate Data and Load into customeraggregatespend Table
• Aggregate `TotalAmount` from `ordersummary` table, grouping by `Name` and `Date`.
• Load the aggregated data into `customeraggregatespend` table.
